notices.title: The jukebox is open
notices.body: Pull the lever and the old Elmgrove theme starts up. The soundtrack slots are locked for now, but the goblins are working on the key. Keep your ears out.

notices.title: Digging out our old jam games
notices.body: We went down to the cellar with a lantern and found a pile of old jam games. Dusted them off, gave them a shelf in the back room. Some of them are very small and very proud.

notices.title: A peek at the treehouse
notices.body: New planks, new cabinets, and a draft that smells faintly of emeralds. Sit down, stay a while, and mind the roots.
